description: This file defines the EmbeddedURLForDailymotion class that processes and generates embedded URLs for Dailymotion videos within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the AbstractBuzzVideoURL class and provides methods to validate and convert Dailymotion URLs into embed URLs based on specific regex patterns.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForDailymotion
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing and generating embedded URLs for Dailymotion videos.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Generates and returns the embedded URL for Dailymotion videos if the original URL is valid and matches expected patterns.
